evidence.why: Complete character-specific equality ladders, distinct exceptional paths, timed removal and final animation-completion test.

facts.rationale: Corrects the baseline conflation of spawn failure with obstruction cleanup and of final article removal with fighter-state exit, while preserving exact threshold and branch behavior.
facts.value: For Link and Young Link, counter equalities xA4, xA8, xAC and xB0 respectively select article creation, obstruction-checked deployment with sound, the next article operation with sound, and article removal. Samus uses xBC, xC0, xC4 and xC8 for the parallel sequence without those local sound calls. The counter increments by 1.0 per supported-character animation update, and ordered equality branches determine which operation executes. Spawn failure calls ftCo_800968C8 without returning or explicitly removing an article. Obstructed deployment removes the article, calls ftCo_800968C8 and returns immediately. The final article threshold only removes the article. All paths that reach the final animation test call ftCo_800968C8 when no frames remain, including a spawn-failure path that already called it.
